notes.en:
**Summary and General Analysis**

✦ Sushang has a 33% chance to trigger "Sword Stance" on the final hit of her Skill, dealing an additional instance of damage to an enemy target.

✦ If the enemy target is Weakness Broken, "Sword Stance" is guaranteed to trigger and her speed will be increased via her Talent.

✦ Her ultimate forces her to immediately take action, and increases the "Sword Stance" damage instances by 2. These extra instances deal half the damage of the original "Sword Stance" hit
